parent_company: Microvast Holdings, Inc.
research_notes:
Microvast's primary/original battery cell manufacturing site, located at ~2198 Hongfeng Road, Wuxing District, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province, China (postcode 313000). It is a wholly-owned subsidiary site (not a JV). The plant manufactures Li-ion cells (pouch format), historically NMC/NCM chemistry, and Microvast's flagship HpCO 53.5Ah/55Ah NMC cells; cells serve both commercial EV and energy-storage (ESS) markets, hence end_market = mixed.

CAPACITY / STATUS: Site is operational and has produced cells for years. As of 31 Dec 2024, total Huzhou annual manufacturing capacity was ~3.5 GWh. The Phase 3.2 expansion adds ~2 GWh/yr (HpCO cell line), with equipment installed/commissioned by end-2025 and initial (SOP) production ramping in Q1 2026, moving toward full-series production during 2026. Combined primary lines + Phase 3.1 + Phase 3.2 give roughly ~4 GWh/yr; nameplate_capacity_gwh=4 reflects this ~2026 figure. NOTE: sources describe multiple overlapping "phases" and capacity numbers are somewhat noisy — 3.5 GWh (2024) vs ~4 GWh (post-3.2) — treat the ramp JSON as approximate. A 2017 Huzhou environmental approval referenced an original project scope of 11 GWh/yr lithium-ion battery & systems (long-term permitted ceiling, NOT current installed nameplate) — do not use 11 GWh as installed capacity.

COORDINATES: latitude/longitude are approximate, derived from the company's Hongfeng Road, Wuxing District, Huzhou address (city/road level, not a verified site survey). Confidence held at 0.7 due to noisy capacity figures and approximate coordinates. announced_year=2017 reflects the original project approval date (Huzhou Municipal Ecology Bureau, 14 Jul 2017); start_year left null as exact first-production year for the current facility is not cleanly sourced (Microvast has manufactured in Huzhou since roughly 2008-2010). Corroborating sources: Microvast Q3 2025 and Q1 2026 investor materials/earnings, Seeking Alpha "Microvast Doubles Down In Huzhou", BeyondSPX Phase 3.2 coverage, MarkLines/Panjiva supplier records for address.
